measurement_contract.export_ms: File-to-file export: native write_to(BufWriter<File>) or Terrio write_raster_dataset, including sync_all and output metadata; excludes fixture construction.
measurement_contract.peak_rss: Fresh export process: fixture, adapter conversion, and writer allocations; native is not forced to buffer a full encoded output Vec. /usr/bin/time reports process peak resident memory.
measurement_contract.process_wall_ms: Python subprocess elapsed time, including process startup, fixture construction, file export, and exit; includes time wrapper on performance runs.
measurement_contract.bytes: Actual output file length, checked against binary stdout JSON.
measurement_contract.overview_oracle: Direct full-source factor-2^n clipped blocks; ceil dimensions until max <=512; nodata excluded; alpha-weighted colors and mean alpha; categorical full-block center; f64 mean to f32 then integer round half-up.
measurement_contract.correctness: Exact sample equality (including float32), no numerical or performance acceptance thresholds. Validator warnings retained, errors fail. All cases and both writers attempted despite failures.
measurement_contract.deflate_level: Writer configuration is level 6; TIFF compression tags verify Deflate, but the zlib stream does not uniquely prove the configured compression level.
measurement_contract.performance_order: Sequential alternating native/Terrio writers each repetition; no concurrent exports or warmup omission.
